text:
alex: Heads up — planning a JIT pin for runtime -> sdk2.9 in EU canary during the 02:00 UTC change window. Observed ~0.3% decoding errors on longseq with runtime v3.8 + sdk2.9. Proposing to route the longseq-eu cohort to runtime v3.7 for a soft pin and collect extra telemetry. Thoughts?

mia: what threshold are we using for a pin trigger? last time we used 0.5% decoding errors.

sre-luke: @deploybot can we create a temporary soft pin rule scoped to model group `longseq-eu` with auto-rollforward in 2h if telemetry is stable?

deploybot: deploybot: queued request — will create pin rule once someone confirms gate and schedule. need: group id, target runtime, start_ts, rollback_window.

qa-ron: can we gate on both `decoding_err_rate` and `token_ooms`? want to avoid rolling forward if OOMs appear. Also we should update release notes and ping support.

eva: I'll wire a dashboard tile and an alert for the decoding metric. add me for telemetry access.

alex: gate proposal: ``decoding_err_rate >= 0.2% OR token_ooms > 0`` measured over 30m. action: pin (soft) to runtime v3.7 for longseq-eu cohort at 02:00 UTC. rollback: auto-rollforward after 2h if both metrics under thresholds for 30m. I'll update release notes. :thumbsup:

mia: clarify: this is a soft pin (no SLA change) and should be listed in pinlist.csv with `soft=true`.

alex: correct — soft pin only. deploybot will do cohort routing, no infra change.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled soft pin id `pin-1708991234` for group `longseq-eu` -> target runtime `v3.7`. start_ts=1708998000 (02:00 UTC), rollback_window=7200s (2h), auto-unpin condition=metrics_clear.

sre-luke: runbook snippet: ```bash
# quick check for decoding errors
curl -sS "https://telemetry.internal/api/metrics?metric=decoding_err_rate&group=longseq-eu&window=30m"
# lift pin
curl -X POST "https://deploybot.internal/pins/pin-1708991234/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

alex: thanks. @qa-ron can you run a preflight eval at 01:30 UTC against a 1k-sample prompt set and post results in this thread?

qa-ron: on it. ETA ~01:45 UTC. will include diff vs v3.8. :eyes:

deploybot: deploybot: reminder scheduled for 01:25 UTC to run preflight automation.

eva: dashboard tile `jit-pin-longseq-eu` created and pager rule added: trigger if decoding_err_rate > 0.5% for 5m. Slack alert to #incidents and pager SRE on-call.

alex: perfect. unless anyone objects, we'll proceed with scheduling.

mia: no objections from me. proceed.

qa-ron: preflight done at 01:44 UTC — no regression on 1k sample. decoding_err_rate=0.12% (v3.7) vs 0.31% (v3.8). OOMs=0. Posting small sample of failing prompt ids: 534, 1210, 1984.

eva: got the preflight data, graphs look good. I'll keep dashboard pinned during the window.

sre-luke: good to go from SRE side. I'll watch the alert and be ready to lift pin manually if needed.

alex: thanks everyone — proceeding to final schedule. will paste release-note blurb here shortly.
